description: This file defines a 'Marker' class for managing map markers in a Leaflet-based map component, including marker creation, icon handling, tooltip updates, and event management within a mapping module of a widget system.

classes.name: Marker
classes.description: Represents a map marker with customizable icon, tooltip, label, and event handling capabilities, integrated with Leaflet map library.

methods.name: setDataSources
methods.description: Updates the marker's data and data sources, and attaches data to the marker options.

methods.name: updateMarkerTooltip
methods.description: Updates the tooltip content based on current data and settings, with support for custom functions and patterns.

methods.name: updateMarkerPosition
methods.description: Sets a new position for the marker if it has changed and is not in editing mode.

methods.name: updateMarkerLabel
methods.description: Updates the marker's label tooltip with pattern processing and styling.

methods.name: updateMarkerColor
methods.description: Changes the marker's icon color by creating a new icon with the specified color.

methods.name: updateMarkerIcon
methods.description: Creates and sets a new icon for the marker, updating label offsets accordingly.

methods.name: createMarkerIcon
methods.description: Generates a marker icon based on settings, including image loading and color customization.

methods.name: createDefaultMarkerIcon
methods.description: Creates a default icon for the marker, either colored or from cache.

methods.name: createColoredMarkerIcon
methods.description: Creates a colored SVG icon for the marker.

methods.name: createColorIconURI
methods.description: Generates a data URI for an SVG icon filled with the specified color.

methods.name: removeMarker
methods.description: Placeholder for marker removal logic (currently commented out).

methods.name: extendBoundsWithMarker
methods.description: Extends a given map bounds to include this marker's position.

methods.name: getMarkerPosition
methods.description: Returns the current geographical position of the marker.

methods.name: setMarkerPosition
methods.description: Sets the marker's position to a specified latitude/longitude.
